results.notes: Wizard draft only, never Create Analysis; API write guard on. Brand analysis > Decathlon (decathlon.com) > United Kingdom - English (EN), AI Insights English (EN) > discovery returned Outdoor Gear + Sports Apparel, Sports Apparel removed (confirm "Remove") = 40 prompts GB (EN). Dashboard pool 996 / 1000 at start, so S = 40 could not be kept: 36 unticked, 4 kept (the 4 first rows, all Brand Image / Overview) -> "1000 / 1000 prompts · 4 selected" + "Pool full. Any prompt you add must be balanced by an untick before launch.". Ring identical (1000 / 1000 · 4 selected) before, after Gemini off and after Gemini on. The Summary stepper is aria-disabled from Prompts, so Summary was re-entered with Review & Launch. The parenthetical "(on an existing analysis, its Prompts column does not depend on its number of engines)" was not re-checked (no creation allowed); supporting evidence from the 20/10 run TC-GEO-1237-010 (133 prompts x 3 engines -> pool +133, Prompts column 133). Side observation (not part of this TC): with the 4 kept prompts all in Brand Image, Summary showed "Categories: Outdoor Gear dropped" and "At least one category needs a kept prompt. Go back to Prompts and tick at least one prompt in a category. Create Analysis stays disabled until then." - consistent with the category-drop rule. Wizard closed with Back to Dashboard > "Exit setup?" > Exit and Discard; dashboard pool still 996 / 1000.
